thesis: Apple's services segment is structurally undervalued. A re-rating to 20x EV/EBITDA on a $112B services run-rate supports a $230 price target.
variant_view: Bear case: services growth decelerates to 8% as App Store regulation intensifies and hardware saturation limits install-base expansion; PT $175 on 14x services multiple.

risks.description: EU Digital Markets Act forces sideloading and App Store fee cuts, reducing services margin by 200-400bps.
mitigants: Apple can partially offset via Apple One bundle pricing
Non-App-Store services (Apple TV+, iCloud) not affected

conflicts.description: Financial analyst assumes 13% services CAGR; risk assessor flags regulatory drag implying 9-10% CAGR.
conflicts.resolution: Used 11% blended CAGR in base case; assigned 30% probability weight to bear scenario.

falsification_conditions.description: Services revenue growth falls below 8% YoY for two consecutive quarters.

next_evidence_needed: App Store developer survey on fee sensitivity post-DMA
Management commentary on Vision Pro attach rates in Q2 FY2026 call
Third-party data on iCloud paid subscriber growth
